name: tool-eval-bench
description: Evaluate tool-calling quality and benchmark self-hosted model endpoints with deterministic scenarios and conversation traces.
compatibility: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints; additional hosted-provider adapters.
Python 3.11 or newer; optional Docker deployment.
limitations: Tests assistant conversations with mock tools, not full agent systems or multi-agent handoffs.
Difficulty tiers are author estimates; localization coverage is German-focused.
